why: The six repositories that produced the only claim this company rests on: top-three by fix history misses 1.21% of the changes a later fix returns to, against alphabetical's 3.12%, n=2400, McNemar p<1e-6, 6 of 6 positive. Recorded here because the commit each was measured at was previously written down NOWHERE -- the run read a scratchpad path under /private/tmp belonging to a session that has since ended, and the result artefact stores only hit/alpha_hit booleans, so neither the code nor the data named the corpus. These SHAs were verified by re-running defect_return.py against the surviving clones and reproducing all 2400 events exactly.
